title: What Space Solar 2.0 Arrays Is
definition: Space Solar 2.0 Arrays: orbital solar farms beaming power to Earth at scale.
description:
Space Solar 2.0 Arrays: orbital solar farms beaming power to Earth at scale. This is Future Energy Systems at its most ambitious — collector wings research, array logistics engineering and beam targeting operations converging on a single goal: making array hulls real.

Why it matters: Future Energy Systems will decide assembly robots outcomes this century. Space Solar 2.0 Arrays is one of the load-bearing ideas: without working array hulls, the larger collector wings vision stalls, and with it, the array logistics systems that depend on it.

definition: Today's documented research behind Space Solar 2.0 Arrays.

Long-duration storage (iron-air batteries, Form Energy) targets 100-hour grid backup. Together these programs form the collector wings foundation that Space Solar 2.0 Arrays will build on — the array logistics results, the beam targeting methods, and the institutional memory.

title: Space Solar 2.0 Arrays Master Roadmap
definition: The united roadmap for Space Solar 2.0 Arrays: prove, build, operate, compound.
description:
The master roadmap for Space Solar 2.0 Arrays — orbital solar farms beaming power to Earth at scale.

Phase 1 — Prove (collector wings): laboratory demonstrations of every component, replicated independently. No scaling until the physics is boring.

Phase 2 — Build (array logistics): pilot manufacturing and integration. The six pieces meet for the first time and the interfaces get honest.

Phase 3 — Operate (beam targeting): continuous real-world operation. Uptime, cost curves and failure data replace projections.

Phase 4 — Compound (assembly robots): array hulls as everyday infrastructure. Costs collapse, standards settle, and geosynchronous orbit-scale deployment begins.

Public edition: phases follow documented research readiness. This record unites the database: overview, research, components, milestones, demos and drills all point here.
